Around [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] issued a '''vote''' to give [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] client [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] seats in the Senate. It was most notable as being [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] first moment in the political spotlight.

In his speech to the Senate, Palpatine announced that, according to the wishes of his [[Monarch of Naboo|king]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] and his constituents on Naboo, he would be abstaining from the vote. The vote was later passed, giving the Trade Federation greater voting power and influence in the Senate.

Palpatine's abstention earned him the animosity of Senator [[Pax Teem]] of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]], who had been hoping that the new young Senator would be in a mood to vote his way. This played an essential part in Palpatine's kidnapping by [[Santhe Security]] agents hired by Teem.

Unbeknownst to all, however, the vote was a further part of the obscure [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]], orchestrated by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], who appeared in public as the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] Hego Damask, Magister of the lobbying company [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], and his secret apprentice, Darth Sidious, a.k.a. Palpatine. Plagueis's plan was for the new member-worlds to be caught between a Republic that heavily taxed them and a Federation that exploited them to foment discontent and pave the way for a future [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession crisis]] that would eventually destroy the Republic.
